name: Clare Chimdindu Chukwu
bio: Clare Chukwu is a passionate medical student dedicated to advocacy and community health, driven by a deep commitment to serving underrepresented populations. As the Director of Sports for the Nile University Medical Student's Association (NUMSA), she champions the fight for total inclusivity in sports, ensuring every student has the opportunity to participate. Clare is known for her dynamic leadership and tireless work ethic in promoting holistic well-being among her peers.
